subject.title: Redesign usage share card around model activity

question: Should CodexBar adopt this bounded model/source-centric share-card direction now, or defer it until the canonical dashboard-versus-share-artifact contract is explicitly approved?
rationale: The patch adds a new user-facing reporting story and chooses what model/source, activity, and spend claims the exported artifact should make; current discussion identifies that contract as a product-design decision rather than an established behavior contract.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded card direction
options.body: Approve the share-card scope after the branch rebases and corrects its data/date contract, keeping the dashboard and card as intentionally separate surfaces.

options.title: Defer to the canonical design thread
options.body: Keep the existing artifact until the contract in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2290 is settled, then request a narrower implementation against that decision.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded card direction
recommendation.body: Approve the share-card scope after the branch rebases and corrects its data/date contract, keeping the dashboard and card as intentionally separate surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the adjacent correctness boundary and is the strongest available routing signal for the share-card data contract.
